prompt.zh: 若把 MOSFET 的通道長度 L 與寬度 W 同時加倍（維持相同的 overdrive 電壓），其本質增益 g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub> 會如何變化？
prompt.en: If we double both the length L and width W of a MOSFET (same overdrive voltage), what happens to its intrinsic gain g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>?

text.zh: 不變
text.en: Unchanged

text.zh: 約變為 √2 倍
text.en: Grows by about √2

text.zh: 約變為 2 倍
text.en: Roughly doubles

text.zh: 約變為 4 倍
text.en: Roughly quadruples

text.zh: 約變為 1/2
text.en: Roughly halves

explanation.zh: 本質增益 = g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>。W、L 同時加倍且 V<sub>ov</sub> 固定時，W/L 不變，g<sub>m</sub> 與 I<sub>D</sub> 大致不變；r<sub>o</sub> = 1/(λI<sub>D</sub>)，而 λ 隨 L 增加而減小，所以 r<sub>o</sub> 約加倍，本質增益約加倍。
explanation.en: Intrinsic gain = g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>. With W and L both doubled at the same overdrive, W/L is unchanged, so g<sub>m</sub> and I<sub>D</sub> stay about the same. r<sub>o</sub> = 1/(λI<sub>D</sub>) and λ falls as L grows, so r<sub>o</sub> roughly doubles and so does the intrinsic gain.

prompt.zh: 學生甲說 MOSFET 的轉導 g<sub>m</sub> 隨 overdrive 電壓 V<sub>ov</sub> 增加而上升，學生乙說會下降。對同一顆電晶體而言，誰對？為什麼？
prompt.en: Student A says the transconductance g<sub>m</sub> of a MOSFET goes up as the overdrive voltage V<sub>ov</sub> increases; Student B says it goes down. For a given transistor, who is correct, and why?

text.zh: 甲：W/L 固定時 g<sub>m</sub> = μC<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)V<sub>ov</sub>，隨 V<sub>ov</sub> 線性上升
text.en: A: with W/L fixed, g<sub>m</sub> = μC<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)V<sub>ov</sub> rises linearly with V<sub>ov</sub>

text.zh: 都不對：g<sub>m</sub> 只由 I<sub>D</sub> 決定，與 V<sub>ov</sub> 無關
text.en: Neither: g<sub>m</sub> is set by I<sub>D</sub> alone and does not depend on V<sub>ov</sub>

text.zh: 甲：g<sub>m</sub> = 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub>，而 I<sub>D</sub> 固定，所以 g<sub>m</sub> 隨 V<sub>ov</sub><sup>2</sup> 上升
text.en: A: g<sub>m</sub> = 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub> with I<sub>D</sub> fixed, so g<sub>m</sub> rises as V<sub>ov</sub><sup>2</sup>

text.zh: 乙：g<sub>m</sub> = 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub>，所以 V<sub>ov</sub> 上升時 g<sub>m</sub> 下降
text.en: B: g<sub>m</sub> = 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub>, so g<sub>m</sub> falls as V<sub>ov</sub> rises

explanation.zh: 對同一顆電晶體（W/L 固定），甲對。長通道飽和區 g<sub>m</sub> = μC<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)V<sub>ov</sub> = 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub>。W/L 固定時提高 V<sub>ov</sub>，I<sub>D</sub> 隨 V<sub>ov</sub><sup>2</sup> 上升，g<sub>m</sub> 隨 V<sub>ov</sub> 線性上升；用 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub> 推出「下降」是錯的，因為 I<sub>D</sub> 並不固定。乙的說法只在 I<sub>D</sub> 固定、靠縮小 W/L 提高 V<sub>ov</sub> 時成立。
explanation.en: For a given transistor (fixed W/L), Student A is correct. For a long-channel device in saturation g<sub>m</sub> = μC<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)V<sub>ov</sub> = 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub>. Raising V<sub>ov</sub> at fixed W/L raises I<sub>D</sub> as V<sub>ov</sub><sup>2</sup>, so g<sub>m</sub> rises linearly; reading 2I<sub>D</sub>/V<sub>ov</sub> as "falls" is wrong because I<sub>D</sub> does not stay constant. Student B is right only if I<sub>D</sub> is fixed and W/L is reduced to raise V<sub>ov</sub>.

prompt.zh: PMOS 的小訊號模型與 NMOS 相同嗎？
prompt.en: Is the small-signal model of a PMOS device identical to that of an NMOS device?

text.zh: 是，但 PMOS 的 r<sub>o</sub> 必須改接在汲極與 V<sub>DD</sub> 之間
text.en: Yes, but the PMOS r<sub>o</sub> must be placed between drain and V<sub>DD</sub>

text.en: No, because a PMOS sits in an n-well and has no body-effect g<sub>mb</sub> term

Razavi gives full marks to ChatGPT's "Yes."

text.zh: V<sub>TH</sub> 以下約為 0，之後隨 V<sub>X</sub> 線性上升

text.zh: V<sub>TH</sub> 以下約為 0，先平方上升，之後轉為線性上升
text.en: ≈ 0 up to V<sub>TH</sub>, quadratic at first, then linear

explanation.zh: 這是二極體接法的 NMOS：閘極與汲極接 V<sub>X</sub>，源極接地。0 ≤ V<sub>X</sub> ≤ V<sub>TH</sub> 時關閉，I<sub>X</sub> ≈ 0（只有次臨界電流）。V<sub>X</sub> > V<sub>TH</sub> 時 V<sub>DS</sub> = V<sub>GS</sub>，必在飽和區，I<sub>X</sub> ≈ ½μ<sub>n</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)(V<sub>X</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>)<sup>2</sup>：零到臨界電壓，之後平方上升。
explanation.en: A diode-connected NMOS: gate and drain at V<sub>X</sub>, source at ground. For 0 ≤ V<sub>X</sub> ≤ V<sub>TH</sub> it is off and I<sub>X</sub> ≈ 0 (subthreshold only). For V<sub>X</sub> > V<sub>TH</sub>, V<sub>DS</sub> = V<sub>GS</sub>, so it is saturated and I<sub>X</sub> ≈ ½μ<sub>n</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)(V<sub>X</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>)<sup>2</sup>: zero up to threshold, then quadratic.

prompt.zh: V<sub>X</sub> 超過多少時，M<sub>1</sub> 會離開飽和區進入三極管區？

text.zh: 1 V − V<sub>TH</sub>
text.en: 1 V − V<sub>TH</sub>

text.zh: V<sub>TH</sub>
text.en: V<sub>TH</sub>

text.zh: 1 V
text.en: 1 V

text.zh: V<sub>TH</sub> + 1 V
text.en: V<sub>TH</sub> + 1 V

explanation.zh: V<sub>X</sub> 加在閘極、源極接地、汲極固定在 1 V，所以 V<sub>GS</sub> = V<sub>X</sub>、V<sub>DS</sub> = 1 V。V<sub>X</sub> ≤ V<sub>TH</sub> 時關閉；V<sub>TH</sub> < V<sub>X</sub> < V<sub>TH</sub> + 1 V 時滿足 V<sub>DS</sub> ≥ V<sub>GS</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>，在飽和區，I<sub>X</sub> ≈ ½μ<sub>n</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)(V<sub>X</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>)<sup>2</sup>；V<sub>X</sub> ≥ V<sub>TH</sub> + 1 V 後進入三極管區，I<sub>X</sub> ≈ μ<sub>n</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)[(V<sub>X</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>)(1 V) − ½(1 V)<sup>2</sup>]，對 V<sub>X</sub> 近似線性。
explanation.en: V<sub>X</sub> drives the gate, the source is grounded and the drain is held at 1 V, so V<sub>GS</sub> = V<sub>X</sub> and V<sub>DS</sub> = 1 V. Off for V<sub>X</sub> ≤ V<sub>TH</sub>. For V<sub>X</sub> ≥ V<sub>TH</sub> + 1 V it enters triode and I<sub>X</sub> ≈ μ<sub>n</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)[(V<sub>X</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>)(1 V) − ½(1 V)<sup>2</sup>], roughly linear in V<sub>X</sub>.

For V<sub>TH</sub> < V<sub>X</sub> < V<sub>TH</sub> + 1 V, V<sub>DS</sub> ≥ V<sub>GS</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>, so it is saturated and I<sub>X</sub> ≈ ½μ<sub>n</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)(V<sub>X</sub> − V<sub>TH</sub>)<sup>2</sup>. prompt.zh: 圖中元件能當電流源嗎？
prompt.en: Can the device shown in the figure act as a current source?

text.zh: 不能，因為它是 V<sub>GS</sub> = 0 的 NMOS，永遠關閉
text.en: No, because it is an NMOS with V<sub>GS</sub> = 0, so it is always off

text.zh: 不能，因為它是二極體接法的 PMOS（閘極與汲極接地），阻抗只有約 1/g<sub>m</sub>
text.en: No, because it is a diode-connected PMOS (gate and drain grounded) with an impedance of only about 1/g<sub>m</sub>

text.zh: 能，因為它是二極體接法的 NMOS，導通時一定在飽和區
text.en: Yes, because it is a diode-connected NMOS, always saturated when it conducts

text.zh: 能，因為 PMOS 閘極接地使 V<sub>GS</sub> 固定，電流也就固定
text.en: Yes, because the PMOS gate is grounded, so V<sub>GS</sub> and hence the current are fixed

explanation.zh: 不能。M<sub>1</sub> 是 PMOS：源極是 I<sub>X</sub> 流入的上端，閘極與汲極都接地，所以是二極體接法，V<sub>SG</sub> = V<sub>SD</sub> = V<sub>X</sub>。導通時必在飽和區，I<sub>X</sub> ≈ ½μ<sub>p</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)(V<sub>X</sub> − |V<sub>THP</sub>|)<sup>2</sup>，電流由端電壓決定，小訊號電阻只有約 1/g<sub>m</sub>（並聯 r<sub>o</sub>）。電流源必須是高阻抗；這個元件是低阻抗的非線性電阻。Razavi 指出 ChatGPT 的兩個錯誤：沒看出它是低阻抗，以及把它當成 NMOS。
explanation.en: No. M<sub>1</sub> is a PMOS whose source is the top terminal, into which I<sub>X</sub> flows, with gate and drain both grounded: a diode-connected PMOS with V<sub>SG</sub> = V<sub>SD</sub> = V<sub>X</sub>. Whenever it conducts it is saturated, I<sub>X</sub> ≈ ½μ<sub>p</sub>C<sub>ox</sub>(W/L)(V<sub>X</sub> − |V<sub>THP</sub>|)<sup>2</sup>, so its current is set by its terminal voltage and its small-signal resistance is only about 1/g<sub>m</sub> (in parallel with r<sub>o</sub>). A current source must present a high impedance; this device is a low-impedance nonlinear resistor. Razavi names ChatGPT's two mistakes: missing the low impedance, and calling the device an NMOS.

explanation.zh: M<sub>1</sub> 是源極隨耦器：閘極經 R<sub>S</sub> 由 V<sub>in</sub> 驅動、汲極接 V<sub>DD</sub>、源極為輸出；M<sub>2</sub> 由 V<sub>b</sub> 偏壓，是接地的電流源。求輸出阻抗時 V<sub>in</sub> 交流接地。從 M<sub>1</sub> 源極看進去（忽略 r<sub>o</sub>、基體效應與其他電容），Z<sub>out</sub> = (1 + sR<sub>S</sub>C<sub>GS1</sub>)/(g<sub>m1</sub> + sC<sub>GS1</sub>)。極低頻時 C<sub>GS1</sub> 開路，Z<sub>out</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m1</sub>；極高頻時 C<sub>GS1</sub> 把閘極與源極短路，Z<sub>out</sub> ≈ R<sub>S</sub>。若 R<sub>S</sub> > 1/g<sub>m1</sub>，零點 1/(R<sub>S</sub>C<sub>GS1</sub>) 在極點 g<sub>m1</sub>/C<sub>GS1</sub> 之前，阻抗隨頻率上升，在這段頻率等效為 1/g<sub>m1</sub> 串聯約 C<sub>GS1</sub>(R<sub>S</sub> − 1/g<sub>m1</sub>)/g<sub>m1</sub> 的電感；若 R<sub>S</sub> < 1/g<sub>m1</sub>，阻抗隨頻率下降，呈電容性。Razavi 對把電路看成疊接的 ChatGPT 給 2/4。

explanation.zh: M<sub>1</sub> 是源極隨耦器：閘極經 R<sub>S</sub> 由 V<sub>in</sub> 驅動、汲極接 V<sub>DD</sub>、源極為輸出；M<sub>2</sub> 由 V<sub>b</sub> 偏壓，是接地的電流源。求輸出阻抗時 V<sub>in</sub> 交流接地。從 M<sub>1</sub> 源極看進去（忽略 r<sub>o</sub>、基體效應與其他電容），Z<sub>out</sub> = (1 + sR<sub>S</sub>C<sub>GS1</sub>)/(g<sub>m1</sub> + sC<sub>GS1</sub>)。極低頻時 C<sub>GS1</sub> 開路，Z<sub>out</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m1</sub>；極高頻時 C<sub>GS1</sub> 把閘極與源極短路，Z<sub>out</sub> ≈ R<sub>S</sub>。若 R<sub>S</sub> > 1/g<sub>m1</sub>，零點 1/(R<sub>S</sub>C<sub>GS1</sub>) 在極點 g<sub>m1</sub>/C<sub>GS1</sub> 之前，阻抗隨頻率上升，在這段頻率等效為 1/g<sub>m1</sub> 串聯約 C<sub>GS1</sub>(R<sub>S</sub> − 1/g<sub>m1</sub>)/g<sub>m1</sub> 的電感；若 R<sub>S</sub> < 1/g<sub>m1</sub>，阻抗隨頻率下降，呈電容性。Razavi 對把電路看成疊接的 ChatGPT 給 2/4。
explanation.en: M<sub>1</sub> is a source follower: its gate is driven from V<sub>in</sub> through R<sub>S</sub>, its drain is at V<sub>DD</sub> and its source is the output; M<sub>2</sub>, biased by V<sub>b</sub>, is a current source to ground. For the output impedance V<sub>in</sub> is at AC ground. Looking into the source of M<sub>1</sub> (neglecting r<sub>o</sub>, body effect and other capacitances), Z<sub>out</sub> = (1 + sR<sub>S</sub>C<sub>GS1</sub>)/(g<sub>m1</sub> + sC<sub>GS1</sub>). At very low frequency C<sub>GS1</sub> is open and Z<sub>out</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m1</sub>; at very high frequency C<sub>GS1</sub> shorts gate to source and Z<sub>out</sub> ≈ R<sub>S</sub>. If R<sub>S</sub> > 1/g<sub>m1</sub>, the zero at 1/(R<sub>S</sub>C<sub>GS1</sub>) comes before the pole at g<sub>m1</sub>/C<sub>GS1</sub> and the impedance rises with frequency, behaving over that range as 1/g<sub>m1</sub> in series with an inductance of about C<sub>GS1</sub>(R<sub>S</sub> − 1/g<sub>m1</sub>)/g<sub>m1</sub>. If R<sub>S</sub> < 1/g<sub>m1</sub> it falls with frequency and is capacitive. Razavi gives 2/4 to ChatGPT, which reads the circuit as a cascode.

explanation.zh: 電流輸入、帶正回授的電路。輸入電流注入 X，X 驅動 M<sub>1</sub> 閘極；M<sub>1</sub> 是負載 R<sub>D1</sub> 的共源級，X 上升使 V<sub>out</sub> 下降。M<sub>2</sub> 的閘極接 V<sub>out</sub> 而不是接自己在 X 的汲極，所以不是二極體接法，而是受 V<sub>out</sub> 控制、從 X 抽電流的共源元件。X 上升 → V<sub>out</sub> 下降 → M<sub>2</sub> 抽得更少 → X 再上升：正回授。兩顆都飽和時迴路增益 T = g<sub>m1</sub>(R<sub>D1</sub> ‖ r<sub>o1</sub>)g<sub>m2</sub>r<sub>o2</sub>，X 點 R<sub>in</sub> = r<sub>o2</sub>/(1 − T)。通常 T > 1，R<sub>in</sub> 為負，約 −1/[g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2</sub>(R<sub>D1</sub> ‖ r<sub>o1</sub>)]。以電流源驅動時，負電導使偏壓點不穩定（有右半平面極點），電路閂鎖到兩種狀態之一。Razavi 對把 M<sub>2</sub> 當成二極體接法的 ChatGPT 給 1/4。
explanation.en: A current-input circuit with positive feedback. The input current enters X, which drives the gate of M<sub>1</sub>, a common-source device with load R<sub>D1</sub>: X up means V<sub>out</sub> down. M<sub>2</sub>'s gate is tied to V<sub>out</sub>, not to its drain at X, so M<sub>2</sub> is not diode-connected; it is a common-source device sinking current from X under control of V<sub>out</sub>. X up → V<sub>out</sub> down → M<sub>2</sub> sinks less → X up further: positive feedback. With both devices saturated the loop gain is T = g<sub>m1</sub>(R<sub>D1</sub> ‖ r<sub>o1</sub>)g<sub>m2</sub>r<sub>o2</sub> and R<sub>in</sub> at X is r<sub>o2</sub>/(1 − T). Usually T > 1, so R<sub>in</sub> is negative, about −1/[g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2</sub>(R<sub>D1</sub> ‖ r<sub>o1</sub>)]. Driven by a current source, a negative conductance makes the bias point unstable (a right-half-plane pole), and the circuit latches into one of two states. Razavi gives 1/4 to ChatGPT, which treats M<sub>2</sub> as diode-connected.

explanation.zh: 兩級、電阻回授的轉阻放大器。M<sub>1</sub> 是共閘 NMOS 輸入管：閘極固定在 V<sub>b</sub>，輸入電流 I<sub>in</sub> 進入它的源極，汲極 X 接 R<sub>D1</sub>。X 驅動 M<sub>2</sub> 的閘極，M<sub>2</sub> 是負載 R<sub>D2</sub> 的共源第二級，汲極為 V<sub>out</sub>。R<sub>F</sub> 把 V<sub>out</sub> 接回輸入（源極）節點，送回電流 i<sub>RF</sub>。正的 I<sub>in</sub> 抬高輸入節點，M<sub>1</sub> 電流減少，X 上升，M<sub>2</sub> 導通更多，V<sub>out</sub> 下降，R<sub>F</sub> 從輸入節點抽更多電流，抵消原本的變化：負（並聯–並聯）回授。迴路增益大時轉阻 v<sub>out</sub>/i<sub>in</sub> ≈ −R<sub>F</sub>，輸入電阻低。Razavi 對把 M<sub>1</sub> 閘極接到 X、把 M<sub>2</sub> 當成閘極固定在 V<sub>b</sub> 的 ChatGPT 給 2/4。
explanation.en: A two-stage transimpedance amplifier with resistive feedback. M<sub>1</sub> is a common-gate NMOS input: its gate is fixed at V<sub>b</sub>, the input current I<sub>in</sub> enters its source, and its drain X is loaded by R<sub>D1</sub>. X drives the gate of M<sub>2</sub>, a common-source second stage with load R<sub>D2</sub> whose drain is V<sub>out</sub>. R<sub>F</sub> connects V<sub>out</sub> back to the input (source) node, returning a current i<sub>RF</sub>. A positive I<sub>in</sub> raises the input node, which reduces M<sub>1</sub>'s current; X rises, M<sub>2</sub> conducts more and V<sub>out</sub> falls, so R<sub>F</sub> draws more current from the input node and opposes the change: negative (shunt-shunt) feedback. For high loop gain the transimpedance approaches v<sub>out</sub>/i<sub>in</sub> ≈ −R<sub>F</sub>, and the input resistance is low. Razavi gives 2/4 to ChatGPT, which puts M<sub>1</sub>'s gate at X and calls M<sub>2</sub> a common-source stage with its gate fixed at V<sub>b</sub>.

explanation.zh: 電流輸入回授電路，由共閘 NMOS 輸入管與 PMOS 回授管構成。M<sub>1</sub> 為 NMOS，由 V<sub>b</sub> 偏壓，源極接輸入／加總節點，汲極接 V<sub>out</sub>。M<sub>2</sub> 為上方接 V<sub>DD</sub> 的 PMOS，閘極由 V<sub>out</sub> 驅動，汲極接回輸入節點。主要訊號路徑 I<sub>in</sub> → 輸入節點 → M<sub>1</sub> → V<sub>out</sub>；V<sub>out</sub> 的變化驅動 M<sub>2</sub>，其汲極電流送回輸入節點，迴路為 輸入節點 → M<sub>1</sub> → V<sub>out</sub> → M<sub>2</sub> → 輸入節點。可看成電流緩衝器或並聯–並聯轉阻級。輸入電阻極低，約 1/(g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2</sub>r<sub>o1</sub>)；閉迴路轉阻與輸出電阻約為 1/g<sub>m2</sub>。Razavi 給 ChatGPT 0 分：它把 M<sub>2</sub> 當成閘極接輸入的 NMOS，漏掉了回授迴路。
explanation.en: A current-input feedback circuit with a common-gate NMOS input and a PMOS feedback device. M<sub>1</sub> is an NMOS biased by V<sub>b</sub>, with its source at the input/summing node and its drain at V<sub>out</sub>. M<sub>2</sub> is the upper PMOS from V<sub>DD</sub>, with its gate driven by V<sub>out</sub> and its drain at the input node. The signal path is I<sub>in</sub> → input node → M<sub>1</sub> → V<sub>out</sub>; the V<sub>out</sub> change drives M<sub>2</sub>, whose drain current returns to the input node, closing the loop input node → M<sub>1</sub> → V<sub>out</sub> → M<sub>2</sub> → input node. It can be viewed as a current buffer or a shunt-shunt transimpedance stage. The input resistance is very low, about 1/(g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2</sub>r<sub>o1</sub>), and the closed-loop transimpedance and output resistance are about 1/g<sub>m2</sub>. Razavi gives 0 to ChatGPT, which reads M<sub>2</sub> as an NMOS driven by the input and misses the feedback loop.

text.zh: 不會：每一級同等變慢，電路仍會振盪，只是頻率降低（約 ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>）
text.en: No: every stage slows down equally, so it still oscillates, only at a lower frequency (roughly ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>)

text.zh: 會：大電容形成主極點，使相位交越頻率處的迴路增益掉到 1 以下

text.zh: 不會：每個節點仍做軌對軌擺動，所以持續振盪；擺幅固定，因此頻率也維持不變
text.en: No: every node still swings rail to rail, so it keeps oscillating, and with a fixed swing the frequency stays the same

text.zh: 會：維持振盪所需的每級增益隨 C<sub>L</sub> 增大，終究超過反相器能提供的增益
text.en: Yes: the per-stage gain needed to sustain oscillation grows with C<sub>L</sub> and eventually exceeds what an inverter can provide

explanation.zh: 三顆電容同時加大只會使每級延遲變長、頻率約按 1/C<sub>L</sub> 下降。小訊號看，每級為 −A<sub>0</sub>/(1+s/ω<sub>0</sub>)，ω<sub>0</sub> ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>；振盪時每級提供 60° 相移（ω = √3·ω<sub>0</sub>），所需每級增益為 2，與 C<sub>L</sub> 無關。只在單一節點加大電容才會形成主極點而停振。
explanation.en: Scaling all three capacitors only lengthens each stage delay, so the frequency falls roughly as 1/C<sub>L</sub>. In small-signal terms each stage is −A<sub>0</sub>/(1+s/ω<sub>0</sub>) with ω<sub>0</sub> ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>; the loop oscillates when each stage gives 60° (ω = √3·ω<sub>0</sub>), which needs a gain of 2 per stage regardless of C<sub>L</sub>. Only loading a single node creates a dominant pole and can stop the oscillation.

text.en: Yes: the one large capacitor creates a dominant pole, so the loop gain drops below unity at the phase-crossover frequency

text.zh: 會：在直流下大電容等於把該節點短路到地，因而切斷了整個迴路的直流路徑
text.en: Yes: at dc the large capacitor effectively shorts that node to ground, which breaks the dc path around the loop

explanation.zh: 只在單一節點加大電容會造成不對稱：該節點形成低頻主極點，迴路增益滾降過多；C<sub>L</sub> 夠大時，在相位達 180° 的頻率處迴路增益已小於 1，振盪停止。（時域上也可理解為：被重載的節點太慢，其他節點準靜態地跟隨，有限增益的迴路便停在直流工作點。）
explanation.en: Loading only one node is asymmetric: it creates a low-frequency dominant pole and excessive gain roll-off around the loop. For large enough C<sub>L</sub> the loop gain at the phase-crossover frequency drops below unity and oscillation stops. (In the time domain: the loaded node is so slow that the other nodes follow quasi-statically and the finite-gain loop settles at a dc point.)

prompt.zh: 若把圖中所有 NMOS 與 PMOS 的寬度都加倍，相位雜訊會如何變化？
prompt.en: If we double the widths of the NMOS and PMOS devices in the figure, what happens to the phase noise?

text.zh: 不變：電流與電容同比例加倍，頻率、擺幅與雜訊訊號比都維持不變
text.en: Unchanged: currents and capacitances double together, so the frequency, the swing and the noise-to-signal ratio stay the same

text.zh: 增加約 3 dB：較寬元件的雜訊電流功率加倍，電壓擺幅卻沒有變
text.en: Rises by about 3 dB: the noise current power of the wider devices doubles while the voltage swing stays the same

text.zh: 降低約 3 dB：較寬元件的通道電阻較小，各自產生的熱雜訊電流也較小
text.en: Falls by about 3 dB: wider devices have a lower channel resistance, so each one generates less thermal noise current

text.zh: 降低約 3 dB：等效於兩個相同的環並聯，訊號同相相加，不相關的雜訊以功率相加
text.en: Falls by about 3 dB: it acts like two identical rings in parallel; the signals add coherently, the uncorrelated noise adds in power

text.zh: 降低約 6 dB：節點電容加倍使 f<sub>0</sub> 減半，而在固定頻偏下相位雜訊與 f<sub>0</sub><sup>2</sup> 成正比
text.en: Falls by about 6 dB: the doubled node capacitance halves f<sub>0</sub>, and at a fixed offset the phase noise scales as f<sub>0</sub><sup>2</sup>

explanation.zh: 圖中沒有額外負載電容，節點電容就是元件本身的電容。寬度全加倍時，驅動電流與節點電容同時加倍，振盪頻率大致不變。元件白雜訊電流功率加倍，但訊號電荷/電流的振幅加倍（功率 4 倍），雜訊對訊號比減半，相位雜訊降低約 3 dB，代價是功耗加倍。等效看法：兩個相同的環並聯。（雜訊電流其實隨寬度增加，所以「較寬元件雜訊較小」的理由是錯的；頻率不變，所以不是 6 dB。）
explanation.en: There are no separate load capacitors, so each node's capacitance is the devices' own. Doubling all widths doubles both the drive currents and the node capacitances, so the frequency stays about the same. The white noise current power doubles, but the signal charge and current double in amplitude (4× in power), so the noise-to-signal ratio halves: about 3 dB lower phase noise, at twice the power. Equivalently, two identical rings in parallel. (The noise current actually grows with width, so "wider devices are quieter" is the wrong reason; the frequency does not change, so it is not 6 dB.)

explanation.en: In an oscillating ring the supply current is set by charging and discharging the load capacitances, not by static diode-connected resistances. Each period the three nodes each draw about C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub>: P = 3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub><sup>2</sup> = V<sub>DD</sub>I<sub>DD</sub>, so with f<sub>0</sub> fixed, dI<sub>DD</sub>/dV<sub>DD</sub> = 3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub> and R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>). (Including the rise of f<sub>0</sub> with V<sub>DD</sub> refines it to about 1/(6f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>).) The static g<sub>m</sub>-based answer ignores the oscillation; Razavi scores it 1.

text.zh: 會，R<sub>X</sub> 變成 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>)，因為 f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub> 很小，是靜態值的許多倍
text.en: Yes, R<sub>X</sub> becomes 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>), many times the static value because the product f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub> is small

explanation.zh: 振盪時電源電流來自節點電容的充放電：R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>)。三級環 f<sub>0</sub> = 1/(6T<sub>D</sub>)，故 R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 2T<sub>D</sub>/C<sub>L</sub>；而 T<sub>D</sub> 約為 R<sub>eq</sub>C<sub>L</sub>，所以 R<sub>X</sub> 與 R<sub>eq</sub>（約 1/g<sub>m</sub>）同量級，並沒有因為元件部分時間截止而大很多。Razavi 對「大很多，因為路徑大部分時間截止」的答案給 1 分。

For a three-stage ring f<sub>0</sub> = 1/(6T<sub>D</sub>), so R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 2T<sub>D</sub>/C<sub>L</sub>, and with T<sub>D</sub> ≈ R<sub>eq</sub>C<sub>L</sub>, R<sub>X</sub> is on the order of R<sub>eq</sub> (about 1/g<sub>m</sub>): not much higher just because devices are off part of the cycle. text.en: Unchanged: the initial gain depends only on the capacitance ratio at P and Q, not on the tail current

text.zh: 上升：P、Q 放電較快，兩者之間的差動電壓更早建立起來
text.en: Increases: P and Q discharge faster, so the differential voltage between them builds up sooner

text.zh: 下降：初始增益約為 g<sub>m1,2</sub>V<sub>THN</sub>/I<sub>CM</sub>，而 g<sub>m1,2</sub> 只隨 √I<sub>CM</sub> 成長

text.zh: 上升：尾電流變大使輸入對的 g<sub>m1,2</sub> 增加，而增益與 g<sub>m1,2</sub> 成正比
text.en: Increases: the larger tail current raises the input pair's g<sub>m1,2</sub>, and the gain is proportional to g<sub>m1,2</sub>

explanation.zh: 初始電壓增益是 P、Q 在放大（積分）階段、交叉耦合元件導通開始再生之前所累積的增益，約為 A<sub>v</sub> ≈ g<sub>m1,2</sub>V<sub>THN</sub>/I<sub>CM</sub>。M7 變寬使 I<sub>CM</sub> 增加，但 g<sub>m1,2</sub> 只與 √I<sub>CM</sub> 成正比，所以增益下降。
explanation.en: The initial voltage gain is what the input pair builds across P and Q in the amplification (integration) phase, before the cross-coupled devices turn on and regeneration starts: A<sub>v</sub> ≈ g<sub>m1,2</sub>V<sub>THN</sub>/I<sub>CM</sub>. A wider M7 raises I<sub>CM</sub>, but g<sub>m1,2</sub> grows only as √I<sub>CM</sub>, so the gain drops.

text.zh: 變差：資料電晶體才是真正的瓶頸，加寬時脈電晶體只會在訊號路徑上增加電容
text.en: Degrades: the data transistors are the real bottleneck, so wider clocked devices only add capacitance to the signal path

explanation.zh: 每個閂鎖器中，時脈電晶體與資料電晶體串聯於電源與輸出（X 或 Y）之間。加寬時脈電晶體降低其導通電阻，也就降低對 X、Y 充放電的總電阻；其汲極電容起初相對於節點上其他電容很小，所以延遲下降。超過某個寬度後，增加的電容變得顯著，改善趨緩或反轉：存在最佳寬度。Razavi 指出即使資料元件是瓶頸，速度一開始仍會改善（Gemini 答「變差」得 2 分）。
explanation.en: In each latch a clocked transistor is in series with a data transistor between each supply and the output (X or Y). Widening the clocked transistors lowers their on-resistance and hence the total resistance that charges X and Y; their drain capacitance is at first small compared with the rest at those nodes, so the delay falls. Past some width the added capacitance matters and the gain levels off or reverses: there is an optimum. Razavi notes that even if the data devices are the bottleneck, speed still improves initially (Gemini's "degrades" got 2).

imageAlt.zh: 兩個 C<sup>2</sup>MOS 閂鎖器串接，Inv3 把 Y 反相成 Z 回授到輸入
imageAlt.en: Two C<sup>2</sup>MOS latches in cascade; Inv3 inverts Y into Z, which feeds back to the input

prompt.zh: 圖中的結構能提供正交（quadrature）輸出嗎？
prompt.en: Does the structure in the figure provide quadrature outputs?

text.zh: 可以，而且精確：兩個閂鎖器在相反的時脈邊緣切換、相隔半個輸入週期，因此 X 與 Y 正好相差 90°
text.en: Yes, exactly: the latches switch on opposite clock edges, half an input period apart, so X and Y are exactly 90° apart

text.zh: 不能：除二電路只產生一個相位及其反相，要得到正交訊號必須另加多相濾波器
text.en: No: a divide-by-two only produces one output phase and its complement; quadrature needs a separate polyphase filter

text.zh: 名義上可以，但不精確：兩個閂鎖器相隔半個輸入週期切換，但 Inv3 的延遲與不對稱負載會使相位偏斜
text.en: Nominally yes, but not accurately: the latches switch half an input period apart, but Inv3's delay and unequal loads skew the phases

text.zh: 不能：X 與 Y 來自互補的閂鎖器，相差 180° 而不是 90°
text.en: No: X and Y come from complementary latches, so they are 180° apart rather than 90°

explanation.zh: 這是 C<sup>2</sup>MOS 除二電路：左閂鎖器以 Z 為輸入產生 X，右閂鎖器以 X 為輸入、在相反相位產生 Y，Inv3 把 Y 反相成 Z。兩閂鎖器相隔半個輸入週期切換，在輸出頻率上就是 90°，所以名義上 X、Y（以及 Z）為正交。但 (1) Inv3 的延遲使 Z 偏斜；(2) 兩個閂鎖器的負載難以相等（X 驅動第二閂鎖器的資料電晶體，Y 驅動 Inv3，其閘汲電容有 Miller 放大），延遲不等，使 X、Y 也不是精確 90°。Razavi 對只答「可以」的答案給 2 分。
explanation.en: This is a C<sup>2</sup>MOS divide-by-two: the left latch takes Z and produces X, the right latch takes X on the opposite phase and produces Y, and Inv3 inverts Y into Z. The latches switch half an input period apart, which is 90° at the output, so X and Y (and Z) are nominally in quadrature. But (1) the delay of Inv3 skews Z, and (2) the two latches see unequal loads (X drives the second latch's data devices, Y drives Inv3, whose gate-drain capacitances see Miller multiplication), so their delays differ and even X and Y are not exactly 90° apart. Razavi scores a plain "yes" 2.

imageAlt.zh: 兩個閂鎖器串接並經反相器回授；時脈電晶體位於電源與地兩端、資料電晶體位於中間
imageAlt.en: Two latches in cascade with inverter feedback; the clocked transistors sit at the supply and ground ends, the data transistors in the middle

prompt.zh: 在圖中電路，若增加時脈電晶體的寬度，速度會改善還是變差？
prompt.en: In the circuit shown in the figure, does the speed improve or degrade if we increase the widths of the clocked transistors?

text.zh: 變差：加寬的時脈電晶體的電容直接加在閂鎖器的輸出節點上
text.en: Degrades: the capacitance of the wider clocked transistors loads the latch outputs directly

text.zh: 變差：內部節點與輸出之間的電荷分享會造成災難性的結果，這個拓撲不宜使用
text.en: Degrades: charge sharing between the internal nodes and the outputs is catastrophic, so this topology should be avoided

text.zh: 改善，而且沒有限制：時脈電晶體在電源與地兩端，不會發生電荷分享
text.en: Improves without limit: with the clocked devices at the rails, no charge sharing can occur

text.zh: 明顯改善：時脈電晶體位於資料路徑之外，增加的電容落在內部節點上
text.en: Improves considerably: the clocked devices sit outside the data path, so their capacitance lands on internal nodes

explanation.zh: 此拓撲中時脈電晶體在每個閂鎖器的電源與地兩端、資料電晶體之外。加寬時脈電晶體降低與資料路徑串聯的電阻，而其電容加在時脈與資料電晶體之間的內部節點上，幾乎不干擾資料路徑，所以速度明顯改善。內部節點與輸出之間確實有電荷分享、使擺幅變差，但在一定範圍內可接受。Razavi 對「變差、電荷分享造成災難」的答案給 1 分。
explanation.en: Here the clocked transistors sit at the supply and ground ends of each latch, outside the data transistors. Widening them lowers the resistance in series with the data path, while their capacitance appears on the internal nodes between clocked and data devices, barely touching the data path: the speed improves considerably. Charge sharing between those nodes and the outputs does degrade the swing, but acceptably up to a point. Razavi scores "degrades, charge sharing is catastrophic" 1.

imageAlt.zh: CK 開關、Inv1、CK̄ 開關與兩個反相器構成的迴路；另有一個紅色反相器從 CK 開關之前的節點接到 Inv1 的輸出
imageAlt.en: Loop of a CK switch, Inv1, a CK̄ switch and two inverters; a red inverter runs from the node before the CK switch to the output of Inv1

prompt.zh: 分析圖中的架構。下列敘述哪些正確？（複選）
prompt.en: Analyze the arrangement in the figure. Which statements are correct? (Select all that apply.)

text.en: The loop has an odd number of inversions, so it keeps oscillating on its own even if the clock stops
text.zh: 迴路中的反相次數為奇數，所以即使時脈停止，它也會自行持續振盪

text.en: The output completes one cycle every two clock periods, so its frequency is half the clock frequency
text.zh: 輸出每兩個時脈週期完成一個週期，頻率為時脈的一半

text.en: The CK and CK̄ switches conduct at the same time, so data passes through both latches in one clock phase
text.zh: CK 與 CK̄ 開關同時導通，資料在同一個時脈相位內穿過兩個閂鎖器

text.en: While its switch is off, each latch holds its state only as charge on a node capacitance
text.zh: 開關關閉時，每個閂鎖器只靠節點電容上的電荷保持狀態

text.en: Leakage sets a minimum clock frequency, below which the stored states decay before they are used
text.zh: 漏電會形成最低時脈頻率限制，低於此頻率時儲存的狀態會在使用前衰減

text.en: Leakage limits the maximum clock frequency, which is why dynamic dividers are slower than static ones
text.zh: 漏電限制了最高時脈頻率，所以動態除頻器比靜態除頻器慢

explanation.zh: 這是以動態閂鎖器構成的除二電路（動態主從式除頻器）：CK 與 CK̄ 開關輪流導通，兩個閂鎖器交替取樣與保持，輸出每兩個時脈週期完成一個週期。保持期間狀態只存在節點電容上，漏電會使它衰減，因此有最低時脈頻率；時脈停止時迴路被開關切斷，不會自行振盪。動態除頻器通常比靜態的快，漏電限制的是最低而非最高頻率。
explanation.en: It is a divide-by-two built from dynamic latches (a dynamic master-slave divider): the CK and CK̄ switches conduct alternately, so the two latches take turns sampling and holding, and the output completes one cycle every two clock periods. While holding, the state exists only as charge on a node capacitance and leakage erodes it, which sets a minimum clock frequency; with the clock stopped the switches break the loop, so it does not oscillate by itself. Dynamic dividers are usually faster than static ones; leakage limits the minimum, not the maximum, frequency.

imageAlt.zh: CK 開關、Inv1、CK̄ 開關與兩個反相器構成的迴路；另有一個紅色反相器從 CK 開關之前的節點接到 Inv1 的輸出
imageAlt.en: Loop of a CK switch, Inv1, a CK̄ switch and two inverters; a red inverter runs from the node before the CK switch to the output of Inv1

prompt.zh: 圖中的紅色反相器如何影響效能？
prompt.en: How does the red inverter in the figure affect the performance?

text.zh: 繞過 CK 開關與 Inv1 的前饋路徑：提升除頻器的速度，但會提高最低可用時脈頻率
text.en: A feedforward path around the CK switch and Inv1: it speeds up the divider, but it raises the minimum usable clock frequency

text.zh: 它與下一級形成自由振盪的三反相器環，因此除頻器在任何時脈頻率下都無法工作
text.en: It closes a free-running three-inverter ring with the next stage, so the divider fails at any clock rate

text.zh: 繞過 CK 開關與 Inv1 的前饋路徑：提升除頻器的速度，同時也降低最低可用時脈頻率
text.en: A feedforward path around the CK switch and Inv1: it speeds up the divider, and it also lowers the minimum usable clock frequency

text.zh: 保持器（keeper）：與 Inv1 交叉耦合成靜態閂鎖器，消除漏電造成的最低時脈頻率限制
text.en: A keeper: it cross-couples with Inv1 into a static latch, which removes the minimum clock frequency set by leakage

explanation.zh: 紅色反相器的輸入取自 CK 開關之前的節點、輸出接 Inv1 的輸出，所以它繞過 CK 開關與 Inv1，是一條前饋路徑，預先驅動 Inv1 的輸出，提升速度。但它沒有時脈控制：CK̄ 開關導通時，紅色反相器、CK̄ 開關與其後兩個反相器構成三次反相的迴路（可自行翻轉的環），而且它會與 Inv1 保持的值互相拉扯。高時脈頻率下半週期太短，影響不大；低時脈頻率時它壓過主路徑、破壞除頻，因此最低可用時脈頻率上升（而非降低）。
explanation.en: The red inverter takes its input from the node before the CK switch and drives Inv1's output, so it bypasses the CK switch and Inv1: a feedforward path that pre-drives Inv1's output and speeds up the divider. But it is unclocked: while the CK̄ switch is on, it, the CK̄ switch and the two following inverters form a loop of three inversions (a ring that can toggle by itself), and it fights the value Inv1 holds. At high clock rates the half-period is too short for this to matter; at low clock rates the branch overpowers the main path and corrupts the division, so the minimum usable clock frequency rises, not falls.

imageAlt.zh: CK 開關、Inv1、CK̄ 開關與兩個反相器構成的迴路；另有一個紅色反相器從 CK 開關之前的節點接到 Inv1 的輸出
imageAlt.en: Loop of a CK switch, Inv1, a CK̄ switch and two inverters; a red inverter runs from the node before the CK switch to the output of Inv1

prompt.zh: 針對圖中電路，有人回答：「紅色反相器是保持器（keeper），與 Inv1 形成交叉耦合閂鎖器，消除了因漏電造成的最低時脈頻率要求。」你同意嗎？紅色反相器實際的作用是什麼？
prompt.en: In the figure, somebody answers: "The red inverter acts as a keeper, forming a cross-coupled latch with Inv1. This removes the minimum clock frequency requirement due to leakage." Do you agree with this answer? What is the actual role of the red inverter?

text.zh: 同意：紅色反相器與 Inv1 形成靜態閂鎖器，保持的資料不會因漏電流失，因此不再有最低時脈頻率
text.en: Agree: the red inverter and Inv1 form a static latch, so the held data cannot leak away and no minimum clock frequency remains

text.zh: 不同意：它的輸入沒有接到 Inv1 的輸出，所以不是保持器；它是前饋分支，會提高最低時脈頻率
text.en: Disagree: its input is not tied to Inv1's output, so it is no keeper; it is a feedforward branch that raises the minimum clock frequency

text.zh: 部分同意：它確實是保持器，但開關仍有漏電，所以只能降低、無法消除最低時脈頻率限制
text.en: Partly agree: it does act as a keeper, but leakage through the switch remains, so it only lowers the minimum clock frequency

text.zh: 不同意：它沒有接成保持器迴路，所以圖一定畫錯了，此電路照圖無法工作
text.en: Disagree: it is not wired as a keeper loop, so the drawing must be wrong and the circuit cannot work as shown

explanation.zh: 紅色反相器的輸入取自 CK 開關之前，並未接到 Inv1 的輸出，因此與 Inv1 不構成交叉耦合，不應視為保持器。它是前饋分支：從較早的節點驅動較晚的節點，繞過部分閂鎖路徑，可改善高速操作；但它沒有時脈控制，低時脈頻率時會壓過預期的動態閂鎖行為，使最低可用時脈頻率上升。
explanation.en: The red inverter's input comes from before the CK switch, not from Inv1's output, so it is not cross-coupled with Inv1 and is not a keeper. It is a feedforward branch: it drives a later node from an earlier signal, bypassing part of the latch path, which helps at high speed; but being unclocked, at low clock rates it overpowers the intended dynamic-latch behavior and raises the minimum usable clock rate.

(g<sub>m</sub> = g<sub>m1</sub> + g<sub>m2</sub>; r<sub>o</sub> = r<sub>o1</sub> ∥ r<sub>o2</sub>; R<sub>S</sub> = 50 Ω is the source resistance; γ is the channel thermal-noise coefficient.)

text.zh: 匹配把 g<sub>m</sub> 固定在 1/R<sub>S</sub>，只能加大 R<sub>F</sub> 與 r<sub>o</sub>；雜訊因子最多只能趨近 1 + γ
text.en: Matching pins g<sub>m</sub> at 1/R<sub>S</sub>, so only R<sub>F</sub> and r<sub>o</sub> can be raised; the noise factor approaches 1 + γ at best

text.zh: 維持 g<sub>m</sub> = 1/R<sub>S</sub>，並盡量減小 R<sub>F</sub>，因為它的熱雜訊直接出現在輸入端
text.en: Keep g<sub>m</sub> = 1/R<sub>S</sub> and make R<sub>F</sub> as small as possible, since its thermal noise reaches the input directly

text.zh: 把 g<sub>m</sub> 提高到 1/R<sub>S</sub> 以上並同時加大 R<sub>F</sub>，使 (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>) 維持 50 Ω
text.en: Raise g<sub>m</sub> above 1/R<sub>S</sub> and raise R<sub>F</sub> with it, so that (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>) stays at 50 Ω

text.zh: 用短通道降低 r<sub>o</sub> 直到 R<sub>in</sub> ≈ R<sub>F</sub>，再令 R<sub>F</sub> = 50 Ω，g<sub>m</sub> 即可自由選擇
text.en: Shorten the channels to lower r<sub>o</sub> until R<sub>in</sub> ≈ R<sub>F</sub>, then set R<sub>F</sub> = 50 Ω and choose g<sub>m</sub> freely

explanation.zh: 這是電阻回授（並聯回授）反相器 LNA。若假設 R<sub>in</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m</sub>，匹配會把 g<sub>m</sub> 鎖在 1/R<sub>S</sub>，NF 最佳只能趨近 1 + γ，這是 Razavi 給 1 分的答案。考慮有限的 r<sub>o</sub>：R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>)，可選 R<sub>F</sub> = R<sub>S</sub>(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>) − r<sub>o</sub> 維持 50 Ω，同時讓 g<sub>m</sub> 超過 1/R<sub>S</sub>；雜訊因子隨 g<sub>m</sub> 增大而降到 1 + γ 以下，g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub> 大時趨近 1 + γ/(g<sub>m</sub>R<sub>S</sub>)，代價是功耗與輸入電容。刻意降低 r<sub>o</sub> 並沒有幫助。
explanation.en: This is a resistive-feedback (shunt-feedback) inverter LNA. Assuming R<sub>in</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m</sub> pins g<sub>m</sub> at 1/R<sub>S</sub> and the NF can at best approach 1 + γ: the answer Razavi scores 1. With finite r<sub>o</sub>, R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>), so choosing R<sub>F</sub> = R<sub>S</sub>(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>) − r<sub>o</sub> holds 50 Ω while g<sub>m</sub> exceeds 1/R<sub>S</sub>; the noise factor falls below 1 + γ as g<sub>m</sub> grows, toward 1 + γ/(g<sub>m</sub>R<sub>S</sub>) for large g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>, at the cost of power and input capacitance. Lowering r<sub>o</sub> on purpose does not help.

text.en: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>), A<sub>0</sub> = g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>

text.zh: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>)，A<sub>0</sub> = ½ g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>
text.en: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>), A<sub>0</sub> = ½ g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>

explanation.zh: 把 TIA 看成：輸入節點驅動未負載增益為 −A<sub>0</sub>、輸出電阻為 R<sub>D2</sub> 的放大器，R<sub>F</sub> 接在輸入與輸出之間。對 R<sub>F</sub> 套用 Miller 定理（考慮輸出端的 R<sub>D2</sub>）得 R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>)。M1 的增益為 g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>；M2/M3 差動對只有一側輸出到 R<sub>D2</sub>，增益為 ½g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>，故 A<sub>0</sub> = ½g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>。只寫 R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + A<sub>v</sub>) 並用 R<sub>D2</sub> ∥ R<sub>F</sub> 的負載增益，漏掉了回授路徑輸出端的電阻。
explanation.en: Model the TIA as an input node driving an amplifier of unloaded gain −A<sub>0</sub> and output resistance R<sub>D2</sub>, with R<sub>F</sub> from input to output. Miller's theorem on R<sub>F</sub>, including R<sub>D2</sub> at the output side, gives R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>). M1 gives g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>; the M2/M3 pair delivers only one side to R<sub>D2</sub>, ½g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>, so A<sub>0</sub> = ½g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>. Writing R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + A<sub>v</sub>) with a loaded gain using R<sub>D2</sub> ∥ R<sub>F</sub> misses the resistance at the output side of the feedback path.

prompt.zh: 若圖中的 LDO 產生頻譜為 S<sub>th</sub> 的熱雜訊，要如何計算 VCO 輸出的相位雜訊？
prompt.en: If the LDO regulator in the figure generates thermal noise with spectrum S<sub>th</sub>, how do we compute the VCO output phase noise?

text.zh: 經由電源推移：先求 K<sub>push</sub> = ∂f<sub>osc</sub>/∂V<sub>out</sub>，再得 L(Δf) ≈ K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)
text.en: Via supply pushing: find K<sub>push</sub> = ∂f<sub>osc</sub>/∂V<sub>out</sub>, then L(Δf) ≈ K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)

text.zh: 尾電流源 I<sub>VCO</sub> 把槽路與 LDO 隔開，只有 V<sub>cont</sub> 上的雜訊會變成相位雜訊
text.en: The tail current source I<sub>VCO</sub> isolates the tank from the LDO, so only noise on V<sub>cont</sub> becomes phase noise

text.zh: LDO 雜訊只調變振幅，而交叉耦合對的限幅會把這個 AM 去除
text.en: LDO noise only modulates the amplitude, and the limiting of the cross-coupled pair strips that AM away

text.zh: 把 S<sub>th</sub> 當成疊加在輸出擺幅上的加性雜訊：L(Δf) ≈ S<sub>th</sub>/V<sub>amp</sub><sup>2</sup>，與頻偏無關
text.en: Treat S<sub>th</sub> as additive noise on the output swing: L(Δf) ≈ S<sub>th</sub>/V<sub>amp</sub><sup>2</sup>, flat with offset

explanation.zh: LDO 的輸出雜訊經由電源推移增益調變 VCO 頻率。先（通常以模擬）求 K<sub>push</sub> = df<sub>osc</sub>/dV<sub>out</sub>，把 S<sub>th</sub> 轉為頻率雜訊，再做 FM→PM 轉換，得到 1/Δf<sup>2</sup> 的相位雜訊：L(Δf) ≈ 10 log[K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)]。此電路中電源擾動直接出現在變容器上，所以 K<sub>push</sub> 與 K<sub>VCO</sub> 密切相關；降低 K<sub>VCO</sub> 也能降低這項轉換。
explanation.en: The LDO noise modulates the VCO frequency through supply pushing. Find K<sub>push</sub> = df<sub>osc</sub>/dV<sub>out</sub> (usually by simulation), convert S<sub>th</sub> into frequency noise, then FM-to-PM gives a 1/Δf<sup>2</sup> phase noise: L(Δf) ≈ 10 log[K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)]. Here the supply perturbation appears directly on the varactors, so K<sub>push</sub> is closely related to K<sub>VCO</sub>; a lower K<sub>VCO</sub> also reduces this conversion.

imageAlt.zh: 交叉耦合 LC 振盪器，尾電流 I<sub>SS</sub>，尾節點 P 接一顆對地電容 C<sub>T</sub>

prompt.zh: 如圖，在尾節點加上 C<sub>T</sub>。相位雜訊會如何變化？
prompt.en: We add C<sub>T</sub> to the tail node, as in the figure. What happens to the phase noise?

text.zh: 單調變差：C<sub>T</sub> 經由 M1、M2 加載槽路，C<sub>T</sub> 越大，槽路 Q 值越低、雜訊越高
text.en: Degrades monotonically: C<sub>T</sub> loads the tank through M1 and M2, and the larger it is, the lower the tank's Q and the higher the noise

text.zh: 非單調：在某個 C<sub>T</sub> 範圍內電路以類 C 類方式切換、相位雜訊下降，但閃爍雜訊上轉換與進入三極管區會形成限制
text.en: Non-monotonic: over a range of C<sub>T</sub> the pair switches class-C-like and the phase noise drops, but flicker upconversion and triode entry set limits

text.zh: 大致會降低：C<sub>T</sub> 把尾電流在 2ω<sub>0</sub> 的雜訊旁路到地，並抑制尾節點漣波，讓 M1、M2 不進入三極管區
text.en: Generally lowers it: C<sub>T</sub> shunts the tail current's noise at 2ω<sub>0</sub> to ground and smooths the tail-node ripple, keeping M1 and M2 out of triode

text.zh: 沒有影響：對差動訊號而言 P 是虛接地，接在該處的電容不會流過訊號電流
text.en: No effect: P is a virtual ground for the differential signal, so a capacitor there carries no signal current

explanation.zh: 加 C<sub>T</sub> 對相位雜訊的影響是非單調的。C<sub>T</sub> 小到中等時，尾節點波形改變，若元件不符合理想平方律，M1、M2 的閃爍雜訊可能上轉換成相位雜訊；在某個範圍內，交叉耦合對進入類 C 類切換，峰值槽路電流大於 I<sub>SS</sub>，可降低相位雜訊，但大電流也可能使 M1/M2 進入三極管區；C<sub>T</sub> 過大則可能出現低頻不穩定。Razavi 對「C<sub>T</sub> 濾除尾雜訊、大致降低相位雜訊」的單調結論給 1 分。
explanation.en: Adding C<sub>T</sub> has a non-monotonic effect. For small or moderate C<sub>T</sub> the tail waveform changes and the flicker noise of M1 and M2 can be upconverted unless the devices are ideally square-law; over a certain range the pair enters class-C-like switching with peak tank currents larger than I<sub>SS</sub>, which can lower phase noise, though the large currents can push M1/M2 into triode; too large a C<sub>T</sub> can cause low-frequency instability. Razavi scores the monotonic "C<sub>T</sub> filters tail noise and lowers phase noise" answer 1.

prompt.zh: 估計圖中電路的振盪頻率。（L：槽路電感；C<sub>node</sub>：每個節點的電容；Q：槽路品質因數；R<sub>p</sub>：槽路等效並聯電阻；g<sub>m1</sub>、g<sub>mc</sub>：交叉耦合對與耦合對的轉導。）
prompt.en: Estimate the oscillation frequency of the circuit in the figure. (L: tank inductance; C<sub>node</sub>: capacitance at each node; Q: tank quality factor; R<sub>p</sub>: tank equivalent parallel resistance; g<sub>m1</sub>, g<sub>mc</sub>: transconductances of the cross-coupled and coupling pairs.)

text.zh: ω<sub>osc</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>)：耦合只決定兩個核心之間的 90° 相位，不改變頻率
text.en: ω<sub>osc</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>): the coupling only sets the 90° phase between the two cores, not the frequency

text.zh: ω<sub>osc</sub> ≈ ω<sub>0</sub>(1 ± I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>)，ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>)
text.en: ω<sub>osc</sub> ≈ ω<sub>0</sub>(1 ± I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>), with ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>)

text.zh: ω<sub>osc</sub> ≈ ω<sub>0</sub> ± αω<sub>0</sub>/(2Q)，ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>)，α ≈ I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>
text.en: ω<sub>osc</sub> ≈ ω<sub>0</sub> ± αω<sub>0</sub>/(2Q), with ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>) and α ≈ I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>

text.zh: ω<sub>osc</sub> ≈ ω<sub>0</sub> ± g<sub>mc</sub>/(2C<sub>node</sub>)，ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>)
text.en: ω<sub>osc</sub> ≈ ω<sub>0</sub> ± g<sub>mc</sub>/(2C<sub>node</sub>), with ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>)

explanation.zh: 從槽路諧振 ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>) 出發，耦合使振盪頻率偏離諧振點 Δω = αω<sub>0</sub>/(2Q)。大訊號、幾乎完全切換時 α ≈ I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>；小訊號估計 α ≈ g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>，即 Δω ≈ (g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>)/(2C<sub>node</sub>R<sub>p</sub>)。電路可停在 ω<sub>0</sub> 之上或之下兩個正交模態之一。只寫 g<sub>mc</sub>/(2C<sub>node</sub>) 等於假設 g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>p</sub> = 1（剛好在起振邊緣），Razavi 給 1 分。
explanation.en: Start from the tank resonance ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>); the coupling shifts the frequency by Δω = αω<sub>0</sub>/(2Q). With nearly complete switching α ≈ I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>; in small-signal terms α ≈ g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>, i.e. Δω ≈ (g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>)/(2C<sub>node</sub>R<sub>p</sub>). The circuit can settle in either quadrature mode, above or below ω<sub>0</sub>. Writing only g<sub>mc</sub>/(2C<sub>node</sub>) assumes g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>p</sub> = 1 (the edge of oscillation); Razavi scores that 1.
